findings.title: Personal address makes the warning evidentiary

findings.mechanism: The focus carries speech through قَالَ and أَقُل, capacity through تَسْتَطِيعَ, and self-restraint through صَبْرًا; the added addressee and the wider recalled-warning forms in 68:28 and 2:33 make those carriers meet as a remembered warning being confirmed against conduct.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as a calibrated assessment of Musa's conduct while still recovering the plain rebuke about patience.
findings.containment: This supports a personalizing and evidentiary pressure in the ayah; it does not turn the wider parallels into one universal rule or settle every nuance of لَنْ.
